items.title: Mindbloom
items.subtitle: effects rack
items.description: Six psychedelic effects in series — gliding pitch shifter, swept resonant filter, phaser, jet flanger, dub delay and a shimmer reverb — under one TRIP knob that pushes all of them deeper at once. The face is the Soup Cat, pulling a new one every few seconds.

items.title: Mischief
items.subtitle: synth · drums · rack
items.description: Acid and drill'n'bass in one box: a mono acid synth with accent and slide, a 16-step line that mutates bar to bar, drill drums with ratchets and rolls, a Lorenz attractor driving everything, and six effect slots fed by a patch bay.

items.title: Hydra
items.subtitle: three-oscillator synth
items.description: The 1970s performance synth — three VCOs, an overdriving mixer, a 4-pole ladder filter, two contours — plus three things it never had: a nine-engine digital oscillator, a twelve-route modulation grid, and an arpeggiator with SPICE and DICE.

items.title: BlackWidow
items.subtitle: semi-modular mono synth
items.description: One voice, fully patchable: saw or pulse VCO with drift and glide, a ladder filter that self-oscillates, an envelope you can switch to a drone, and a 32-step sequencer with slides, accents and ratchets across sixteen patterns.

items.title: Ether Radio
items.subtitle: AM/FM radio
items.description: Your track becomes a station you have to tune in. Selectivity, static, fading, crackle, hum, tuning whistles and a speaker — or feed it a real RTL-SDR dongle, or go ON AIR and broadcast your mix over the internet.

items.title: SpectraEye
items.subtitle: analyser
items.description: Spectrum with peak hold and a reference curve from another track, a scrolling spectrogram, loudness to EBU R 128, correlation and a goniometer — and a tuner that reads against A4 = 432 Hz like everything else here.

items.title: Syrup Vox
items.subtitle: vocoder
items.description: Slows a voice down and ruins it, on purpose. Tape drags the pitch with it, stretch holds it; then the vocoder prints the voice onto a synth, a sidechain or a whisper of noise, with tube, fuzz, fold or crush either side.

items.title: Euclid Rings
items.subtitle: drum machine
items.description: Eight tracks, each one a Euclidean ring that spreads its hits as evenly as the maths allows. Every track sends MIDI and plays its own drum voice, so it drives other instruments and makes its own noise at the same time.

items.title: Grainstorm
items.subtitle: graintable synth
items.description: The Malström method: each oscillator plays short grains out of a table of single-cycle frames, so you can scan through the table and shift the formants without touching the pitch. All sixteen tables are generated — no sampled audio in it.

items.title: Loop Repeat
items.subtitle: beat repeat
items.description: Grabs a short take of whatever is going through it, plays it back a set number of times, then grabs a new one — the Loop module out of SunVox. Stutter, glitch and beat-repeat on drums, bass and vocals.

items.title: Snap to C
items.subtitle: sample tuner
items.description: Detects what a sample's pitch actually is and shifts it to the nearest C, so it plays in tune chromatically on an SP-404, a sampler or Simpler. Tape or keep-length, batch a whole folder, drag the WAV straight back out.

items.title: Kelp
items.subtitle: modular + tracker
items.description: A modular synthesiser you patch with cables, driven by a tracker sequencer rather than a piano roll. Modules and effects on one canvas, an inspector for whatever is selected, everything landing in the Output module.

items.title: OSC Link
items.subtitle: OSC bridge
items.description: Puts the MPC Sample on the network. The instrument sends notes, CCs, bend and pressure; the FX version sends levels, bands and onsets; both send tempo and beat, and take eight macros back from TouchOSC or TouchDesigner.

items.title: Custom Projection Commission
items.subtitle: Booking inquiry
items.description: Custom projection mapping for your venue, event, or installation. Includes consultation, design, and on-site setup.
